pr_title: fix: Incorrect multithread path taken for aggregations
pr_body:
Fixes #21325.

Currently, for aggregations, polars takes the wrong path when `allow_threading` is false, and tries to multithread with only one thread. Conversely, it *never* multithreads when `allow_threading` is true. This PR fixes this.

Once this path is enabled, we have to disable multithreading for categorical min/max, as the multithreaded path is the one that causes problems in the linked issue. The current algorithm `slice`s categorical columns into separate components and computes `min/max` on each, and in the process (I think) a new revmap is computed for each slice and results in the wrong result, or for some other reason (the proper min physical isn't returned in each sub-slice). So I have disabled multithreading in the IR planner--let me know if this is the proper place to do this.

issue_context.title: test_categorical_min_max (and probably the actual Categorical APIs) gives wrong answer when POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 (or 2)
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```shell-session
$ POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 pytest -v tests/unit/datatypes/test_categorical.py -k categorical_min_max
```

(In CI I was also seeing this with POLARS_MAX_THREADS=2, but it seems to happen inconsistently on my (much faster than GHA runners) desktop. With 1 it seems to happen consistently on my computer at least.)


### Log output

```shell
tests/unit/datatypes/test_categorical.py::test_categorical_min_max FAILED                                                                                             [100%]

================================================================================= FAILURES ==================================================================================_________________________________________________________________________ test_categorical_min_max __________________________________________________________________________tests/unit/datatypes/test_categorical.py:1004: in test_categorical_min_max
    assert result.to_dict(as_series=False) == {"a": ["foo"], "b": ["bar"], "c": ["foo"]}
E   AssertionError
========================================================================== short test summary info ==========================================================================FAILED tests/unit/datatypes/test_categorical.py::test_categorical_min_max - AssertionError
```

### Issue description

The test fails. If I print out `result.to_dict(as_series=False)` it appears to be `{'a': ['foo'], 'b': ['foo'], 'c': ['foo']}`.

### Expected behavior

The number of threads shouldn't affect the results of the function.

### Installed versions

<details>

```
1.22.0, but also with git main.
```

</details>

review_comments: We can check the column dtype to not be categorical here.
